WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
    SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) as monthly_rev
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20171231'
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
    AND totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT 
  MAX(monthly_rev) as highest_monthly_rev,
  MIN(monthly_rev) as lowest_monthly_rev,
  ROUND((MAX(monthly_rev) - MIN(monthly_rev)) / 1000000.0, 2) as diff_in_millions
FROM monthly_revenue

SELECT 
  MAX(week_sum) as max_weekly
FROM (
  SELECT SUM(daily_rev) as week_sum
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      date,
      SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000 as daily_rev
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
    UNNEST(hits) as hit,
    UNNEST(hit.product) as p
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
      AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
      AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY date
  )
  GROUP BY 
    FLOOR((CASE 
      WHEN SUBSTR(date, 5, 2) = '01' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(date, 7, 2) AS INT64)
      WHEN SUBSTR(date, 5, 2) = '02' THEN 31 + CAST(SUBSTR(date, 7, 2) AS INT64)
      WHEN SUBSTR(date, 5, 2) = '03' THEN 59 + CAST(SUBSTR(date, 7, 2) AS INT64)
      WHEN SUBSTR(date, 5, 2) = '04' THEN 90 + CAST(SUBSTR(date, 7, 2) AS INT64)
      WHEN SUBSTR(date, 5, 2) = '05' THEN 120 + CAST(SUBSTR(date, 7, 2) AS INT64)
      WHEN SUBSTR(date, 5, 2) = '06' THEN 151 + CAST(SUBSTR(date, 7, 2) AS INT64)
    END - 1) / 7.0)
)

SELECT 
  ft.fullVisitorId AS visitor_id
FROM (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date AS first_transaction_date,
    deviceCategory
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      fullVisitorId,
      date,
      device.deviceCategory AS deviceCategory,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY date ASC, visitStartTime ASC) AS rn
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` AS s
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
      AND totals.transactions > 0
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
) ft
JOIN (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) AS first_visit_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` AS s2
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
) fv ON ft.fullVisitorId = fv.fullVisitorId
WHERE ft.deviceCategory = 'mobile'
  AND ft.first_transaction_date > fv.first_visit_date
ORDER BY ft.fullVisitorId

WITH state_drug_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    nppes_provider_state AS state,
    drug_name,
    SUM(total_claim_count) AS total_claims
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
  WHERE nppes_provider_state != ''
  GROUP BY nppes_provider_state, drug_name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    state,
    drug_name,
    total_claims,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY total_claims DESC) AS rn
  FROM state_drug_totals
)
SELECT state, drug_name, total_claims
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY state

WITH yearly_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    state,
    CAST(SUBSTR(_TABLE_SUFFIX, 1, 4) AS INT64) AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1980' AND '1995'
  GROUP BY state, year
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    state,
    year,
    event_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY event_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM yearly_counts
),
top1000 AS (
  SELECT state, year, event_count
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 1000
)
SELECT state, SUM(event_count) AS total_events
FROM top1000
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY total_events DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH wa_stations AS (
  SELECT usaf, wban, name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
  WHERE state = 'WA'
),
rainy_2023 AS (
  SELECT 
    gs.stn,
    gs.wban,
    COUNT(*) AS rainy_days_2023
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023` gs
  INNER JOIN wa_stations ws ON gs.stn = ws.usaf AND gs.wban = ws.wban
  WHERE gs.prcp > 0 AND gs.prcp != 99.99
  GROUP BY gs.stn, gs.wban
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 150
),
rainy_2022 AS (
  SELECT 
    gs.stn,
    gs.wban,
    COUNT(*) AS rainy_days_2022
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022` gs
  INNER JOIN wa_stations ws ON gs.stn = ws.usaf AND gs.wban = ws.wban
  WHERE gs.prcp > 0 AND gs.prcp != 99.99
  GROUP BY gs.stn, gs.wban
)
SELECT 
  ws.name,
  ws.usaf,
  ws.wban,
  r2023.rainy_days_2023,
  r2022.rainy_days_2022
FROM rainy_2023 r2023
INNER JOIN rainy_2022 r2022 ON r2023.stn = r2022.stn AND r2023.wban = r2022.wban
INNER JOIN wa_stations ws ON r2023.stn = ws.usaf AND r2023.wban = ws.wban
WHERE r2023.rainy_days_2023 < r2022.rainy_days_2022
ORDER BY ws.name

WITH weather AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    value/10.0 as precip_mm,
    CASE WHEN value/10.0 > 5 THEN 'rainy' ELSE 'non-rainy' END as weather_condition
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2016`
  WHERE id = 'US1NYKN0025' 
    AND element = 'PRCP' 
    AND qflag IS NULL 
    AND mflag IS NULL
),
trip_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(starttime) as trip_date,
    COUNT(*) as num_trips
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE DATE(starttime) >= '2016-01-01' AND DATE(starttime) <= '2016-12-31'
  GROUP BY DATE(starttime)
)
SELECT 
  w.weather_condition,
  ROUND(AVG(tc.num_trips), 2) as avg_daily_trips
FROM weather w
LEFT JOIN trip_counts tc ON w.date = tc.trip_date
GROUP BY w.weather_condition

-- Final query: top 10 stations by proportion of group rides
WITH round_trips AS (
    SELECT 
        start_station_id,
        end_station_id,
        starttime,
        DATE(starttime) as trip_date,
        EXTRACT(HOUR FROM starttime) as hour_val,
        MOD(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM CAST(starttime AS DATETIME)), 2) as minute_mod,
        bikeid
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
),
window_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        start_station_id,
        trip_date,
        hour_val,
        minute_mod,
        COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM round_trips
    GROUP BY start_station_id, trip_date, hour_val, minute_mod
),
group_trips AS (
    SELECT 
        rt.end_station_id,
        rt.bikeid
    FROM round_trips rt
    JOIN window_counts wc 
        ON rt.start_station_id = wc.start_station_id
        AND rt.trip_date = wc.trip_date
        AND rt.hour_val = wc.hour_val
        AND rt.minute_mod = wc.minute_mod
    WHERE wc.cnt >= 2
),
group_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        end_station_id,
        COUNT(*) as group_trip_count
    FROM group_trips
    GROUP BY end_station_id
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        end_station_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_trips_ending
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    GROUP BY end_station_id
)
SELECT 
    s.name as station_name,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(gc.group_trip_count, tc.total_trips_ending) as proportion_of_group_rides
FROM total_counts tc
JOIN group_counts gc ON tc.end_station_id = gc.end_station_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_stations` s
    ON CAST(tc.end_station_id AS STRING) = s.station_id
WHERE gc.group_trip_count IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY proportion_of_group_rides DESC
LIMIT 10

-- Among the routes where bike is faster than taxi, find the one with the LONGEST average bike duration.
-- That would be the first one ordered by avg_bike_duration DESC.
-- The top result is: 12 Ave & W 40 St -> West St & Chambers St with avg 1483.91 seconds

-- But wait, let me reconsider. The question asks for "the longest average bike duration" among routes faster than yellow taxis.
-- Let me re-read: "which route is faster than yellow taxis and among those, which one has the longest average bike duration?"
-- So we want the route with the LONGEST bike duration that is still faster than the taxi on that route.

-- The answer appears to be: 12 Ave & W 40 St -> West St & Chambers St
-- The start station name is: 12 Ave & W 40 St

-- Let me verify by getting the exact result
WITH top_routes AS (
    SELECT 
        start_station_name,
        end_station_name,
        ROUND(start_station_latitude, 3) as start_lat,
        ROUND(start_station_longitude, 3) as start_lon,
        ROUND(end_station_latitude, 3) as end_lat,
        ROUND(end_station_longitude, 3) as end_lon,
        COUNT(*) as trip_count,
        AVG(tripduration) as avg_bike_duration
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    WHERE starttime >= '2016-01-01' AND starttime < '2017-01-01'
        AND tripduration > 0
    GROUP BY start_station_name, end_station_name, start_station_latitude, start_station_longitude, end_station_latitude, end_station_longitude
    ORDER BY trip_count DESC
    LIMIT 20
),
taxi_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3) as start_lat,
        ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3) as start_lon,
        ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3) as end_lat,
        ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3) as end_lon,
        AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND)) as avg_taxi_duration
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
    WHERE pickup_datetime >= '2016-01-01' AND pickup_datetime < '2017-01-01'
        AND pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL 
        AND pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
        AND dropoff_longitude IS NOT NULL
        AND dropoff_latitude IS NOT NULL
        AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND) > 0
    GROUP BY start_lat, start_lon, end_lat, end_lon
)
SELECT 
    tr.start_station_name,
    tr.end_station_name,
    ROUND(tr.avg_bike_duration, 2) as avg_bike_duration
FROM top_routes tr
INNER JOIN taxi_avg ta 
    ON tr.start_lat = ta.start_lat 
    AND tr.start_lon = ta.start_lon
    AND tr.end_lat = ta.end_lat
    AND tr.end_lon = ta.end_lon
WHERE tr.avg_bike_duration < ta.avg_taxi_duration
ORDER BY tr.avg_bike_duration DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  tz.borough AS pickup_borough,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN (total_amount = 0 OR SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount * 100, total_amount) = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    COUNT(*)
  ) * 100 AS no_tip_percentage
FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` tz
  ON t.pickup_location_id = tz.zone_id
WHERE 
  t.pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2016-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND t.pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2016-01-08 00:00:00'
  AND t.dropoff_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2016-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND t.dropoff_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2016-01-08 00:00:00'
  AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
  AND t.passenger_count > 0
  AND t.trip_distance >= 0
  AND t.tip_amount >= 0
  AND t.tolls_amount >= 0
  AND t.mta_tax >= 0
  AND t.fare_amount >= 0
  AND t.total_amount >= 0
GROUP BY tz.borough

WITH borough_stations AS (
  SELECT 
    borough_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) AS total_stations
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.stations`
  GROUP BY borough_name
),
admissible_entrances AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    s.borough_name,
    s.station_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.station_entrances` se
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.stations` s
    ON se.station_name = s.station_name
  WHERE se.entry = TRUE AND se.ada_compliant = TRUE
),
borough_admissible AS (
  SELECT 
    borough_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) AS stations_with_ada_entrance
  FROM admissible_entrances
  GROUP BY borough_name
)
SELECT 
  bs.borough_name,
  bs.total_stations,
  COALESCE(ba.stations_with_ada_entrance, 0) AS stations_with_ada_entrance,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(ba.stations_with_ada_entrance, 0), bs.total_stations) * 100, 2) AS percentage
FROM borough_stations bs
LEFT JOIN borough_admissible ba ON bs.borough_name = ba.borough_name
ORDER BY percentage DESC

WITH trip_data AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_id,
    duration_sec,
    start_date,
    FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) as ym,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) ORDER BY start_date ASC) as rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) ORDER BY start_date DESC) as rn_desc
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips`
),
first_last AS (
  SELECT 
    ym,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc = 1 THEN duration_sec END), 60) as first_duration_min,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN duration_sec END), 60) as last_duration_min
  FROM trip_data
  GROUP BY ym
),
min_max AS (
  SELECT 
    FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) as ym,
    MIN(duration_sec) / 60.0 as min_duration_min,
    MAX(duration_sec) / 60.0 as max_duration_min
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips`
  GROUP BY ym
)
SELECT 
  fl.ym as year_month,
  fl.first_duration_min,
  fl.last_duration_min,
  mm.max_duration_min,
  mm.min_duration_min
FROM first_last fl
JOIN min_max mm ON fl.ym = mm.ym
ORDER BY fl.ym

WITH trips_filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_id,
    duration_sec,
    start_date,
    start_station_name,
    start_station_id,
    member_gender,
    start_station_id AS station_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips`
  WHERE start_date >= '2014-01-01' 
    AND start_date < '2018-01-01'
),
latest_per_region AS (
  SELECT 
    t.region_id,
    t.name AS region_name,
    f.trip_id,
    f.duration_sec,
    f.start_date,
    f.start_station_name,
    f.member_gender,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.region_id ORDER BY f.start_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM trips_filtered f
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` s 
    ON f.start_station_id = CAST(s.station_id AS INT64)
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_regions` t
    ON s.region_id = t.region_id
)
SELECT 
  region_name,
  trip_id,
  duration_sec,
  start_date,
  start_station_name,
  member_gender
FROM latest_per_region
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_name

WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT b.neighborhood, COUNT(*) as num_stations
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_neighborhoods.boundaries` b
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` s
    ON ST_CONTAINS(b.neighborhood_geom, s.station_geom)
  GROUP BY b.neighborhood
),
incident_counts AS (
  SELECT b.neighborhood, COUNT(*) as num_incidents
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_neighborhoods.boundaries` b
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_sfpd_incidents.sfpd_incidents` i
    ON ST_CONTAINS(b.neighborhood_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(i.longitude, i.latitude))
  GROUP BY b.neighborhood
)
SELECT 
  sc.neighborhood,
  sc.num_stations,
  ic.num_incidents
FROM station_counts sc
JOIN incident_counts ic ON sc.neighborhood = ic.neighborhood
ORDER BY sc.neighborhood

WITH age_under_25 AS (
  SELECT 
    country_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN age < 25 THEN population ELSE 0 END) AS pop_under_25,
    SUM(population) AS total_pop
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population_agespecific`
  WHERE year = 2017
  GROUP BY country_name
)
SELECT 
  country_name,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(pop_under_25, total_pop) * 100 AS pct_under_25
FROM age_under_25
ORDER BY pct_under_25 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  country_name,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(CAST(cumulative_recovered AS FLOAT64), CAST(cumulative_confirmed AS FLOAT64)) * 100, 2) as recovery_rate
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
WHERE date = '2020-05-10' 
  AND aggregation_level = 0 
  AND cumulative_confirmed > 50000
  AND cumulative_recovered IS NOT NULL
  AND cumulative_recovered <= cumulative_confirmed
ORDER BY recovery_rate DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT facility_place_id) FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_vaccination_access.facility_boundary_us_all` WHERE facility_sub_region_1 = 'California') AS vaccine_sites,
  (SELECT SUM(total_pop) FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2018_5yr` WHERE geo_id LIKE '06%') AS total_pop_ca,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT facility_place_id) FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_vaccination_access.facility_boundary_us_all` WHERE facility_sub_region_1 = 'California'),
    (SELECT SUM(total_pop) FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2018_5yr` WHERE geo_id LIKE '06%')
  ) * 1000 AS vaccine_sites_per_1000_people

SELECT 
    c.country_name,
    b.net_migration
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.birth_death_growth_rates` b
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.country_names_area` c
    ON b.country_code = c.country_code
WHERE b.year = 2017
    AND c.country_area > 500
ORDER BY b.net_migration DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH tournament_games AS (
  SELECT 
    season,
    'win' AS label,
    win_seed AS seed,
    win_school_ncaa AS school_ncaa,
    win_market AS market,
    win_name AS name,
    win_alias AS alias,
    lose_seed AS opponent_seed,
    lose_school_ncaa AS opponent_school_ncaa,
    lose_market AS opponent_market,
    lose_name AS opponent_name,
    lose_alias AS opponent_alias,
    win_pts AS points,
    lose_pts AS opponent_points,
    round
  FROM `data-to-insights.ncaa.mbb_historical_tournament_games`
  WHERE season >= 2014
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    season,
    label,
    seed,
    school_ncaa,
    market,
    name,
    alias,
    opponent_seed,
    opponent_school_ncaa,
    opponent_market,
    opponent_name,
    opponent_alias,
    points,
    opponent_points,
    round
  FROM `data-to-insights.ncaa.2018_tournament_results`
),
team_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    season,
    team AS school_ncaa,
    poss_40min,
    pace_rating,
    pace_rank,
    pts_100poss,
    efficiency_rating,
    efficiency_rank
  FROM `data-to-insights.ncaa.feature_engineering`
),
opponent_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    season,
    team AS opponent_school_ncaa,
    poss_40min AS opp_poss_40min,
    pace_rating AS opp_pace_rating,
    pace_rank AS opp_pace_rank,
    pts_100poss AS opp_pts_100poss,
    efficiency_rating AS opp_efficiency_rating,
    efficiency_rank AS opp_efficiency_rank
  FROM `data-to-insights.ncaa.feature_engineering`
)
SELECT 
  tg.season,
  tg.label,
  tg.seed,
  tg.school_ncaa,
  tg.opponent_seed,
  tg.opponent_school_ncaa,
  tm.pace_rank,
  tm.poss_40min AS pace_stat,
  tm.pace_rating,
  tm.efficiency_rank AS eff_rank,
  tm.pts_100poss AS eff_stat,
  tm.efficiency_rating,
  om.opp_pace_rank AS opp_pace_rank,
  om.opp_poss_40min AS opp_poss_40min,
  om.opp_pace_rating AS opp_pace_rating,
  om.opp_efficiency_rank AS opp_eff_rank,
  om.opp_pts_100poss AS opp_pts_100poss,
  om.opp_efficiency_rating AS opp_eff_rating,
  om.opp_pace_rank - tm.pace_rank AS pace_rank_diff,
  om.opp_poss_40min - tm.poss_40min AS pace_stat_diff,
  om.opp_pace_rating - tm.pace_rating AS pace_rating_diff,
  om.opp_efficiency_rank - tm.efficiency_rank AS eff_rank_diff,
  om.opp_pts_100poss - tm.pts_100poss AS eff_stat_diff,
  om.opp_efficiency_rating - tm.efficiency_rating AS eff_rating_diff
FROM tournament_games tg
LEFT JOIN team_metrics tm 
  ON tg.season = tm.season AND tg.school_ncaa = tm.school_ncaa
LEFT JOIN opponent_metrics om 
  ON tg.season = om.season AND tg.opponent_school_ncaa = om.opponent_school_ncaa

WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    workforce,
    report_year,
    race_asian,
    race_black,
    race_hispanic_latinx,
    race_native_american,
    race_white,
    gender_us_women,
    gender_us_men,
    gender_global_women,
    gender_global_men
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation`
  WHERE workforce = 'overall'
),
y2014 AS (
  SELECT * FROM base WHERE report_year = 2014
),
y2022 AS (
  SELECT * FROM base WHERE report_year = 2022
)
SELECT 
  'Asian' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND((y2022.race_asian - y2014.race_asian) * 100, 1) AS growth_rate_percentage_points
FROM y2014, y2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Black people',
  ROUND((y2022.race_black - y2014.race_black) * 100, 1)
FROM y2014, y2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Latinx people',
  ROUND((y2022.race_hispanic_latinx - y2014.race_hispanic_latinx) * 100, 1)
FROM y2014, y2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Native Americans',
  ROUND((y2022.race_native_american - y2014.race_native_american) * 100, 1)
FROM y2014, y2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'White people',
  ROUND((y2022.race_white - y2014.race_white) * 100, 1)
FROM y2014, y2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'US women',
  ROUND((y2022.gender_us_women - y2014.gender_us_women) * 100, 1)
FROM y2014, y2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'US men',
  ROUND((y2022.gender_us_men - y2014.gender_us_men) * 100, 1)
FROM y2014, y2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Global women',
  ROUND((y2022.gender_global_women - y2014.gender_global_women) * 100, 1)
FROM y2014, y2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Global men',
  ROUND((y2022.gender_global_men - y2014.gender_global_men) * 100, 1)

WITH answers AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q ON a.parent_id = q.id
  WHERE a.owner_user_id = 1908967 AND a.creation_date < TIMESTAMP('2018-06-07')
),
answer_votes AS (
  SELECT post_id as answer_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN vote_type_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as upvotes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN vote_type_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as accepted
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.votes`
  WHERE vote_type_id IN (1, 2)
  GROUP BY post_id
)
SELECT t,
  SUM(10 * COALESCE(v.upvotes, 0) + 15 * COALESCE(v.accepted, 0)) as total_score
FROM answers a

WITH matching_clones AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.RefNo, c.CaseNo, c.InvNo, c.Clone
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` c
  INNER JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` c2
    ON c.RefNo = c2.RefNo AND c.CaseNo = c2.CaseNo AND c.InvNo = c2.InvNo AND c.Clone = c2.Clone
  INNER JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` c3
    ON c.RefNo = c3.RefNo AND c.CaseNo = c3.CaseNo AND c.InvNo = c3.InvNo AND c.Clone = c3.Clone
  WHERE 
    c.Chr = 'chr13' AND c.Type = 'Loss' AND c.Start <= 48481890 AND c.`End` >= 48303751
    AND c2.Chr = 'chr17' AND c2.Type = 'Loss' AND c2.Start <= 7687490 AND c2.`End` >= 7668421
    AND c3.Chr = 'chr11' AND c3.Type = 'Gain' AND c3.Start <= 108369102 AND c3.`End` >= 108223067
),
chr13_data AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr13' AND Type = 'Loss' AND Start <= 48481890 AND `End` >= 48303751
),
chr17_data AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr17' AND Type = 'Loss' AND Start <= 7687490 AND `End` >= 7668421
),
chr11_data AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr11' AND Type = 'Gain' AND Start <= 108369102 AND `End` >= 108223067
)
SELECT 
  mc.RefNo,
  mc.CaseNo,
  mc.InvNo,
  mc.Clone,
  c13.ChrOrd AS Chr13_ChrOrd, c13.Start AS Chr13_Start, c13.`End` AS Chr13_End,
  c17.ChrOrd AS Chr17_ChrOrd, c17.Start AS Chr17_Start, c17.`End` AS Chr17_End,
  c11.ChrOrd AS Chr11_ChrOrd, c11.Start AS Chr11_Start, c11.`End` AS Chr11_End,
  k.CloneShort
FROM matching_clones mc
LEFT JOIN chr13_data c13 ON mc.RefNo = c13.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c13.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c13.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c13.Clone AND c13.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN chr17_data c17 ON mc.RefNo = c17.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c17.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c17.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c17.Clone AND c17.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN chr11_data c11 ON mc.RefNo = c11.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c11.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c11.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c11.Clone AND c11.rn = 1

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT 
        a.assay_id,
        a.standard_type,
        a.molregno,
        a.activity_id,
        a.standard_value,
        a.standard_relation,
        a.pchembl_value,
        SAFE_CAST(cp.heavy_atoms AS INT64) as heavy_atoms,
        a.doc_id,
        cs.canonical_smiles,
        a.potential_duplicate
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.activities_29` a
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_properties_29` cp 
        ON a.molregno = cp.molregno
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_structures_29` cs 
        ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
    WHERE SAFE_CAST(cp.heavy_atoms AS INT64) BETWEEN 10 AND 15
        AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
        AND a.standard_value != ''
        AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
        AND a.pchembl_value != ''
        AND SAFE_CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) > 10
        AND a.standard_flag = '1'
        AND a.potential_duplicate = '0'
),
-- Activity count per (assay, standard_type, molregno) - must be < 5
act_counts AS (
    SELECT assay_id, standard_type, molregno, COUNT(*) as act_count
    FROM filtered
    GROUP BY assay_id, standard_type, molregno
    HAVING act_count < 5
),
-- Duplicate count per (assay, standard_type, molregno) - must be < 2
dup_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        assay_id, standard_type, molregno,
        SUM(CASE WHEN potential_duplicate = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dup_count
    FROM filtered
    GROUP BY assay_id, standard_type, molregno
    HAVING dup_count < 2
),
best_activity AS (
    SELECT 
        f.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.assay_id, f.standard_type, f.molregno ORDER BY SAFE_CAST(f.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) DESC) as rn
    FROM filtered f
    JOIN act_counts ac 
        ON f.assay_id = ac.assay_id 
        AND f.standard_type = ac.standard_type 
        AND f.molregno = ac.molregno
    JOIN dup_counts dc 
        ON f.assay_id = dc.assay_id 
        AND f.standard_type = dc.standard_type 
        AND f.molregno = dc.molregno
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT * FROM best_activity WHERE rn = 1
),
doc_base AS (
    SELECT 
        doc_id,
        journal,
        COALESCE(year, '1970') as year_key,
        SAFE_CAST(first_page AS INT64) as first_page_val
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.docs_29`
    WHERE year IS NOT NULL AND year != '' AND first_page IS NOT NULL AND first_page != ''
),
doc_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        doc_id,
        journal,
        year_key,
        first_page_val,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY journal, year_key ORDER BY first_page_val) as rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY journal, year_key) as grp_count
    FROM doc_base
),
doc_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        doc_id,
        CONCAT(
            CAST(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(year_key AS INT64), 1970) AS STRING), '-', 
            LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(LEAST(12, FLOOR(CASE WHEN grp_count > 1 THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(rn - 1, grp_count - 1) * 11 ELSE 0 END) + 1), 1) AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-',
            LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(MOD(CAST(FLOOR(CASE WHEN grp_count > 1 THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(rn - 1, grp_count - 1) * 308 ELSE 0 END) AS INT64), 28) + 1, 1) AS STRING), 2, '0')
        ) as pub_date
    FROM doc_ranked
),
assay_mol_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        q1.assay_id,
        q1.standard_type,
        q1.molregno as molregno_1,
        q1.activity_id as activity_id_1,
        q1.standard_value as standard_value_1,
        q1.standard_relation as standard_relation_1,
        q1.heavy_atoms as heavy_atoms_1,
        q1.doc_id as doc_id_1,
        q1.canonical_smiles as canonical_smiles_1,
        q2.molregno as molregno_2,
        q2.activity_id as activity_id_2,
        q2.standard_value as standard_value_2,
        q2.standard_relation as standard_relation_2,
        q2.heavy_atoms as heavy_atoms_2,
        q2.doc_id as doc_id_2,
        q2.canonical_smiles as canonical_smiles_2
    FROM qualifying q1
    JOIN qualifying q2
        ON q1.assay_id = q2.assay_id
        AND q1.standard_type = q2.standard_type
        AND q1.molregno < q2.molregno
),
with_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        amp.*,
        GREATEST(amp.heavy_atoms_1, amp.heavy_atoms_2) as max_heavy_atoms,
        GREATEST(amp.doc_id_1, amp.doc_id_2) as highest_doc_id,
        dd1.pub_date as pub_date_1,
        dd2.pub_date as pub_date_2,
        GREATEST(dd1.pub_date, dd2.pub_date) as latest_pub_date
    FROM assay_mol_pairs amp
    LEFT JOIN doc_dates dd1 ON amp.doc_id_1 = dd1.doc_id
    LEFT JOIN doc_dates dd2 ON amp.doc_id_2 = dd2.doc_id
),
with_classification AS (
    SELECT 
        wd.*,
        CASE 
            WHEN SAFE_CAST(wd.standard_value_1 AS FLOAT64) > SAFE_CAST(wd.standard_value_2 AS FLOAT64) THEN 'decrease'
            WHEN SAFE_CAST(wd.standard_value_1 AS FLOAT64) < SAFE_CAST(wd.standard_value_2 AS FLOAT64) THEN 'increase'
            ELSE 'no-change'
        END as change_classification
    FROM with_dates wd
),
with_uuids AS (
    SELECT 
        wc.*,
        to_hex(md5(to_json_string(struct(wc.activity_id_1, wc.canonical_smiles_1)))) as uuid_1,
        to_hex(md5(to_json_string(struct(wc.activity_id_2, wc.canonical_smiles_2)))) as uuid_2
    FROM with_classification wc
)
SELECT 
    assay_id,
    standard_type,
    molregno_1,
    molregno_2,
    activity_id_1,
    activity_id_2,
    standard_value_1,
    standard_value_2,
    max_heavy_atoms,
    highest_doc_id,
    latest_pub_date,
    change_classification,
    uuid_1,
    uuid_2
FROM with_uuids
ORDER BY assay_id, molregno_1, molregno_2

WITH user_months AS (
  SELECT `by` as user_id, DATE_TRUNC(DATE(timestamp), MONTH) as activity_month
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.hacker_news.full`
  WHERE timestamp < TIMESTAMP('2024-09-10') AND `by` IS NOT NULL AND `by` != ''
  GROUP BY `by`, activity_month
),
user_spans AS (
  SELECT user_id, MIN(activity_month) as first_month, MAX(activity_month) as last_month,
         COUNT(*) as num_active_months
  FROM user_months
  GROUP BY user_id
),
all_months AS (
  SELECT user_id, first_month, last_month, num_active_months,
         GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(first_month, last_month, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) as month_array
  FROM user_spans
),
flattened AS (
  SELECT user_id, first_month, last_month, num_active_months,
         month as month_in_span,
         DATE_DIFF(month, first_month, MONTH) + 1 as month_number
  FROM all_months, UNNEST(month_array) as month
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT f.user_id, f.month_in_span, f.month_number
  FROM flattened f
  LEFT JOIN user_months u ON f.user_id = u.user_id AND f.month_in_span = u.activity_month
  WHERE u.activity_month IS NULL
),
max_gap_per_user AS (
  SELECT user_id, MAX(month_number) as max_gap_month
  FROM gaps
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT user_id, max_gap_month
FROM max_gap_per_user
ORDER BY max_gap_month DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH user_first_session AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date)) AS first_session_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20181003'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
  HAVING MIN(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date)) >= DATE '2018-07-02'
),
user_cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    first_session_date,
    DATE_SUB(first_session_date, INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM first_session_date) - 2) DAY) AS cohort_monday
  FROM user_first_session
),
user_session_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    user_pseudo_id,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date) AS session_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20181003'
),
user_session_weeks AS (
  SELECT 
    usd.user_pseudo_id,
    usd.session_date,
    DATE_SUB(usd.session_date, INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM usd.session_date) - 2) DAY) AS session_week_monday
  FROM user_session_dates usd
),
cohort_retention AS (
  SELECT 
    uc.cohort_monday,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN usw.session_week_monday = DATE_ADD(uc.cohort_monday, INTERVAL 4 WEEK)
        THEN uc.user_pseudo_id 
      END),
      COUNT(DISTINCT uc.user_pseudo_id)
    ) AS retention_rate_4th_week
  FROM user_cohort uc
  LEFT JOIN user_session_weeks usw
    ON uc.user_pseudo_id = usw.user_pseudo_id
  GROUP BY uc.cohort_monday
)
SELECT cohort_monday
FROM cohort_retention
ORDER BY retention_rate_4th_week DESC
LIMIT 1
